coordinate_system: BodyParts3D body coordinates (same as the STL files): +X = patient left, -Y = anterior, +Z = superior
face_index_note: Face indices refer to triangle order in the original BodyParts3D STL. With three.js STLLoader (non-indexed) triangle i = vertices 3i, 3i+1, 3i+2. A triangle is listed if more than half of its area is inside the preset.
